counting_rule: DSM-5-TR requires ALL THREE criteria A, B and C to be met. There is NO counting threshold over a numbered list, so there are no numbered items to count. The lists inside A and B are given as examples and are ILLUSTRATIVE, not a menu to be satisfied in part.
scored_grain_note: Two scored criteria, A and B. The named components below are ILLUSTRATIVE enumeration, given to the classifier as description text so it has real constructs to match instead of a paragraph, and recorded per term in the `component` field so the roll-up to the criterion is auditable. They are NOT separately scored, because DSM does not count them. Criterion C is onset and is reported in methods rather than scored, per D8.

items.components_provenance: Paraphrased by the project in DSM5_paraphrased/ID_criteria.txt. The names below are the construct names that text uses, listed for the component field only.

excluded_criteria.C: Onset during the developmental period. Reported in methods, not scored, per D8.

worked_examples_provenance: Deliberately empty. See the note in ASD.json. ID has no documented prior over-exclusion to reverse, so supplying mouse-side examples would supply the answer rather than remove a block. The mouse-side mapping recorded in project notes (communication to vocalization, social participation to social investigation and recognition, independent living to nest building, grooming and circadian feeding) is a STAGE 1 target-resolution hypothesis and is deliberately NOT shown to this classifier, so that stage 2a can either corroborate or contradict it.
known_defect_being_fixed: The current ID spine resolves Criterion B's "activities of daily life" to Dyscalculia and Dysgraphia, both human schooling constructs with zero mouse analog, and Criterion A's "Language impairment" pulled a pool made entirely of HEARING terms. The current ID taxonomy also has one undifferentiated adaptive_functioning bucket of 109 strict terms where DSM names three components, so a criterion can look covered without any named component being covered. The component field exists to make that visible.
satisfaction_rule: ILLUSTRATIVE. The components are examples, not a list to be satisfied. A criterion is MET as soon as ANY ONE component has a strict match; there is no partial credit denominator across components and no requirement to cover more than one. Diagnostic gate: A AND B (C is onset, reported not scored). Breadth denominator is 2 units, each far easier to satisfy than an ASD or SCZ item, so raw breadth is NOT comparable across disorders.
comparability_note: Breadth denominators differ across disorders (ASD 7, SCZ 5, ID 2, NCD 2) AND the units differ in difficulty, because DSM counts enumerated items in ASD and SCZ but accepts a single example in ID and NCD. Report fraction of scored units met alongside the raw count, and never rank disorders on raw breadth.
